parameters.name: sumo_external_min_gap_m
parameters.source: SUMO native external-carrier platform setting; this study initialization probe
parameters.rationale: The prescribed dense queue has positive 2m body gaps. Native minGap=2.5 blocks insertion or reports a car-following gap violation despite no body overlap. Explicit zero applies only to the SUMO carrier; physical collisions remain enabled and tested. NOA margins, following gaps and independent geometry thresholds are unchanged.
